title: Jamaican Fried Rice
description: A flavorful twist on the classic dish, featuring Jamaican spices and a crunchy texture.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add Jamaican spice and quaint, cook for 1 minute.
Add flaky and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Push flaky to one side of the pan.
Add a bit more oil if needed, then add rice to the empty side of the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until rice starts to brown.
Mix rice with flaky and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
